verdict.rationale: Asaas documents a dedicated Sandbox environment for testing customers, charges, payments, transfers and Webhooks before using Production credentials. It supports simulated payments, manual charge confirmation and fictitious cards, so testing does not touch production data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of separate sandbox base URLs/API keys and data isolation guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can test flows such as creating customers, charges, payments, transfers, and Webhooks before using Production credentials.
Tests run directly from the API reference use the Sandbox environment.
Simulate the payment in the Sandbox. Receive the corresponding Webhook event.
